narratives.body: Chelsea player Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice from the club despite assurances from coach Xabi Alonso.
narratives.headline: Estevao urged to leave Chelsea despite Alonso promise

narratives.body: Chelsea has been labeled 'bigger and worse offenders' than Manchester City following 114 guilty verdicts.
narratives.headline: Chelsea faces more charges than Man City

narratives.headline: Chelsea player urged to leave after limited playing time
